summary: Tested 3-level image-model selection (global user / per-project / per-generation) on FrameFlow. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed including one REAL OpenAI GPT Image 1 generation that returned frame.provider=='openai' with a valid data:image/... URI (Completed). GET/PUT /api/settings (with invalid->fallback), GET /api/image-provider (models[] shape + default_model), 401 on unauth, and per-project PUT /projects/{pid} data.image_model persistence all verified. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): global Settings tab exposes imgmodel-gemini / imgmodel-openai tiles (both tappable, persist across reload); project 'Settings' tab exposes proj-model-default / proj-model-gemini / proj-model-openai (persist); Storyboard frame cards (after Expand All) show 'AI IMAGE MODEL' chip row with frame-model-default-*, frame-model-gemini-*, frame-model-openai-* for all 8 scenes and selection works without crash. DEV_IMAGE_LIMIT is enforced (project shows '1 AI generation left' after test run). Cascade end-to-end functionality confirmed via real generation + per-project/global persistence endpoints. Cleanup executed: global reset to 'gemini' and per-project image_model=null.

minor.issue: bump_usage(user_id,'image_generations') is called for every generation including mock; not tied to real-cost provider only.
_active_generations is a process-local set; safe today but will not serialize across multi-worker deployments.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated console warnings: 'shadow*' props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated, useNativeDriver missing, [Reanimated] opacity layout-animation warning. Not blocking but noisy. Reference: browser console during any screen load.

Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' emitted on /project/[id] load — likely from a library still passing element.ref. Non-blocking but should be tracked.

action_items: No functional fixes required for this feature — main agent can proceed.
Optional: only bump 'image_generations' usage for real providers (skip when provider is 'mock').
Optional: investigate React 19 element.ref console error source (likely a Reanimated / expo-router internal); watch upstream releases.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_settings/put_settings correctly whitelist against REAL_MODELS and default to 'gemini' — matches spec.
_run_generation resolves effective model with correct precedence (body.model > project.image_model > user.settings.image_model > server default) — matches spec.
resolve_provider() only routes to real providers when model is in REAL_MODELS; unknown model falls back to server default cleanly.
generate_frame passes body.model through to image_service.generate_image — verified end-to-end with real OpenAI call returning provider 'openai'.
MongoDB _id is excluded from all reads via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
